authorization.post_expiry_rule: Do not start, continue, write or notify after the deadline.

daily_funnel.true_inspection_scope: Deadline-day reconciliation of the sole active evidence gap, immutable queue, receipts, morning/evening OSS reports, PMF research and shared budget; no new repository search or execution.

queue_and_execution.largest_blocker: The local runner never proved both an admissible 45-minute remainder and denied access to a known-present coordination object.
queue_and_execution.deadline_rule: Only CLAIM revision 1 if both gates pass before expiry; otherwise do not start, continue, write execution evidence or notify after expiry.

evidence_gap.cheapest_permitted_action_before_expiry: Exact local ledger reconciliation plus a user-reviewed project-backed denied-read proof against known-present coordination material.
evidence_gap.strongest_wasted_work_reason: Additional sourcing cannot improve throughput while the selected replay cannot pass shared admission gates.

DEV_EXECUTION.hypothesis: Verified reusable experience may improve objective developer-agent correctness, reliability or cost.
DEV_EXECUTION.strongest_evidence: Sixteen objective-oracle candidates and one selected deterministic historical replay exist.
DEV_EXECUTION.strongest_counterevidence: Zero verified/archived cases; the selected replay was never admitted.
DEV_EXECUTION.expected_validation_cost: UNKNOWN; selected replay capped at 45 local minutes
DEV_EXECUTION.next_most_informative_action: Under a future manual authorization, first fix runner isolation and accounting before acquiring more tasks.

CONSUMER_COMMERCE.hypothesis: Verified experience may prevent factual and transaction-stage errors in shopping and service selection.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.strongest_evidence: Nine public read-only objective candidates and nine proposed paired designs now cover compatibility, provisional value, price/access tiers, value finality, policy windows and collection responsibility.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.strongest_counterevidence: No authorized paired test, actual use, repeat request, adoption or willingness-to-pay signal exists.
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.plausible_buyer_or_user: Consumer agents, travel/shopping assistants and commerce platforms
CONSUMER_COMMERCE.next_most_informative_action: If manually authorized later, P11 effective-dated baggage policy is the smallest high-information test.

B2B_AGENT_READINESS.hypothesis: Public diagnostics may reveal whether agents can discover and verify SaaS workflows.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.strongest_evidence: No new evidence in this pilot.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.strongest_counterevidence: No objective-oracle candidate or paired opportunity.
B2B_AGENT_READINESS.next_most_informative_action: Wait for a concrete recurring public pain with an objective oracle.

TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.hypothesis: Provenance, compatibility, staleness and outcome receipts can support decisions across other lanes.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.strongest_evidence: Commerce research repeatedly exposed scope, finality and effective-date boundaries that provenance must preserve.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.strongest_counterevidence: No independent execution lane, buyer or paid signal.
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.plausible_buyer_or_user: Platform layer for developer and commerce agents
TRUST_DECISION_LAYER.next_most_informative_action: Evaluate only inside a future authorized A-C experiment.
